name: terraform-aws-reviewbell
description: ReviewBell Lambda — GitHub PR notifications to Slack

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --outfile=dist/index.js --format=cjs --minify && touch -t 198001010000 dist/index.js && mkdir -p lambda && cd dist && zip -X -q -FS ../lambda/handler.zip index.js
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:contract
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:integration
